$comment: Every bundled spelling dictionary, on the assets-src/fonts/fonts.json precedent (PLAN.md §11
M52, and the M14 discipline it copies). Nothing ships without an entry here: the entry names
the upstream, pins the version, records the licence file that must travel with the data, and
carries a SHA-256 of every file so a swapped dictionary cannot arrive unnoticed.
DictionaryManifestTests recomputes all three hashes out of this file and fails on drift.

libreoffice-dictionaries.note: The en_* Hunspell dictionaries generated from SCOWL by speller/make-hunspell-dict.
